notes: kb/Work PB912 + PB842 LANDED (wave 45) and CLOSE this row. It now splices the slot's one value in (a data item's in-place content for the class shape, so IS NUMERIC still sees invalid content). The narrowed COBOL1509 stage had exactly those two callers and is deleted.
